title: Korean parliamentary subcommittee passes electronic financial transactions law amendment with 3% of revenue fine for hacked financial firms
summary: Money Today's breaking-news headline says the Political Affairs Committee's first bill review subcommittee passed an amendment to the electronic financial transactions law, with a fine of 3% of revenue for hacked financial companies. The page text gives no further detail, such as the conditions of the fine.
plain: Money Today reports a Korean parliamentary subcommittee passed an amendment that would fine hacked financial companies 3% of revenue. Details were not given.
exec: A Korean bill that would fine hacked financial firms 3% of revenue cleared a subcommittee, per Money Today's headline.
